engineeringProjects.title: Blockchain Certificate System DApp
engineeringProjects.description: Decentralized application for verifiable academic credentials — Solidity smart contracts handle on-chain issuance and revocation, IPFS stores document hashes, and a React frontend provides trustless verification without a central authority.

engineeringProjects.title: Wildfire Risk Assessment Model
engineeringProjects.description: U-Net CNN trained on Sentinel-2 multispectral satellite imagery to segment high-risk wildfire zones. Achieved 80% training accuracy across California fire corridors — ingesting terrain, vegetation density, and moisture-index channels as input.

engineeringProjects.title: SentrySight
engineeringProjects.description: Real-time AI firearm detection platform with a live interactive demo. Custom object-detection model with sub-100ms inference, responsive alert UI, and a public-facing demo for evaluating accuracy across diverse environments and lighting conditions.

aboutpara: CS graduate (CSUS '25) with a focus on the systems layer where robotics, AI, and software meet the physical world. Currently at Meta Reality Labs via Sigma Design, building low-latency teleoperation interfaces for next-generation robotic systems in production. Previously a Humanoid Test Pilot at Figure AI — evaluating and pushing the boundaries of human-like robot motion. Founder of Vizualty LLC, an independent production and engineering studio active for 8+ years. Outside of work I build at the research frontier: satellite-driven wildfire risk models, on-chain credential systems, and real-time AI detection platforms. I ship with precision across every domain.
